verdict.rationale: The only retention evidence is Agent Analytics' claim that it connects agent use to retention [pendo-docs-9]. That loosely implies measuring retention for a behavioral group (agent users). Segments exist elsewhere in the product [pendo-docs-11, pendo-docs-25], but nothing ties them to retention analysis. Missing for 10: a documented general retention-over-time report or cohort chart, the ability to slice retention by arbitrary behavioral cohorts, and any hands-on or independent corroboration.
